channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] eBay reaches $55.7 million settlement with couple that was sent spiders, bloody pig mask
item.description: eBay has agreed to pay $55.7 million in a settlement with a Massachusetts couple that was the victim of a bizarre harassment and cyberstalking campaign orchestrated by former employees of the company.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FWC provides update on toxic mothballs left on St. Pete Beach in April
item.description: Florida Fish and Wildlife (FWC) said it will provide an update on the report of mothballs being found in St. Pete Beach in April.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Florida Commissioner of Agriculture
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 invited more than 200 candidates running in the Aug. 18 primary election across our area to submit a candidate photo, a 100-word biography, and responses to three questions.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Florida's Attorney General
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 invited more than 200 candidates running in the Aug. 18 primary election across our area to submit a candidate photo, a 100-word biography, and responses to three questions.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Meet the candidates: Questionnaire for Florida US Senate
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 invited more than 200 candidates running in the Aug. 18 primary election across our five-county area to submit a candidate photo, a 100-word biography, and responses questions.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Bucs open training camp amid contract stalemates
item.description: Baker Mayfield and Vita Vea both enter camp without new deals as the Bucs kick off the '26 season. Head coach Todd Bowles shrugged off any concern that the outside noise might affect the locker room.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady despite rising inflation
item.description: The Fed held interest rates steady Wednesday, balancing rising inflation concerns with its dual mandate to support jobs and stable prices.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ICE locking up more parents and children at for-profit detention center in Texas
item.description: An increasing number of parents and children are being held at the nation’s only immigration detention center specially designed to hold families — a reversal of a downward trend earlier this year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Brandon woman considers coming out of retirement to pay for storm damage
item.description: A Brandon woman may have to come out of retirement to help pay for repairs after a summer storm sent a tree crashing into her home.

[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US bans foreign-made humanoid robots, targeting China over national security
item.description: The U.S. Federal Communications Commission is banning imports of new foreign-made humanoid robots and power inverters, citing national security risks, in a move that targets China. Beijing quickly accused the U.S. of protectionism.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FIFA's Infantino sets deadline to members in Kushner-backed World Cup plan
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino set a Sept. 19 deadline on Wednesday for the 211 member federations to accept one-off $20 million offers as part of a project to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Flooding spreads in eastern New York as the heavy rain responsible shifts to New England
item.description: Dangerous flooding is unfolding in eastern New York amid torrential rainfall as a band of slow-moving downpours move toward New England after drenching New Jersey and Pennsylvania on Tuesday.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Iran resumes attacks as US-Saudi strikes kill Tehran-backed militants in Iraq
item.description: Iran launched missiles at U.S. troops Wednesday as American and Saudi forces struck Tehran-backed militants in Iraq, killing at least 20, raising fears of a return to full-scale war.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'Once' Oscar winner and Irish musician Glen Hansard dies in motorcycle crash
item.description: Irish singer-songwriter Glen Hansard, who won an Academy Award for the 2007 film “Once,” died in a motorcycle crash on the outskirts of Dublin early Wednesday, his management said. He was 56.

item.description: A second suspect was arrested in connection with a deadly shooting during a gun transaction inside a bathroom at the Childs Park YMCA in St. Petersburg last week, according to the St. Pete Police Department.
